name: Kona Village, A Rosewood Resort
positioning: Resort of free-standing, thatch-roofed hale on Kahuwai Bay in Kailua-Kona, Hawaii
best_for: Travelers who want ocean activities like snorkeling and canoe paddling on Kahuwai Bay
Groups wanting multi-bedroom kauhale with private pools

facts.text: Kona Village is in Kailua-Kona, Hawaii.
Hale feature oversized lanai and outdoor showers.
The Ocean Front Four Bedroom Maheawalu Kauhale sits on oceanfront lava rock with a private plunge pool and hot tub.
Moana restaurant honors the historic fishing village that once thrived on the site.
Kahuwai Cookhouse has a menu inspired by paniolo, or Hawaiian cowboy, traditions.
Kona Village has four outdoor pools.
The Shipwreck Adult Pool has three tiers, including an infinity hot tub and a lap pool.
Guests can explore the 81-acre resort on complimentary bicycles.
The Asaya Spa lounge has hot tubs, cold plunges, and steam and sauna rooms.
The resort has tennis and pickleball courts.
The Ka'uluola Cultural Center displays artifacts and offers immersive activities on Hawaiian history and culture.
Kahuwai Bay offers snorkeling among vibrant marine life.

highlights.text: Shipwreck Bar was once the schooner of resort founder Johnno Jackson.
The Beach Front Black Sand Two Bedroom Kauhale has a lanai staircase leading directly onto a black sand beach with views of Kahuwai Bay.
Guests stay in free-standing, thatch-roofed hale.
The resort has an on-site farm that provides produce for its restaurants.
Guests can join a sunrise paddle in outrigger canoes around Kahuwai Bay.

considerations.text: One of the four outdoor pools, the Shipwreck pool, is an adult pool.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires planning for off-property activities.
